=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2789-2818 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Shard output is buffered in temp files and not emitted until every shard has been reaped, so a job timeout leaves no pytest output in the step log.
  WHY: Post-mortem diagnosis of a timeout is impossible, and the step exists to address timeouts. Severity disagreement: gemini reported no severity (listed under correctness), luna and glm said NIT. MAJOR is used here because gemini classed it as a correctness issue.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2644-2646,2689-2700,2761-2807 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A serial --collect-only pass imports all 53 modules, and round-robin sharding makes every shard re-import them. The 4-shard saving is an unmeasured estimate.
  WHY: Import overhead is duplicated, which offsets the parallel speedup, and the diff has no timing evidence that group 0 gets headroom under 20 minutes. Severity disagreement: sonnet and minimax said NIT, glm said MAJOR. MAJOR is the highest.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:3740-3757 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: test_partition_covers_the_real_test_functions checks the awk partition arithmetic against an ast.walk-generated list, which is disconnected from the shell script's actual awk and collection path.
  WHY: The test can pass while the shell-side sharding diverges and breaks.
- tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate attributes five suites to this change, but no code path in the diff connects to them. The gate also leaves tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py in the inherited-failure bucket, so it is unconfirmed whether the PR's own contract tests pass.
  WHY: The gate attribution may be wrong, which would send the repair loop after a non-defect. Alternatively the PR's own tests may be failing, so the suites must be rerun on the head SHA. Severity is MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=4

The PR description's AD-2 records this as an approved deviation. Severity: gemini MAJOR, sonnet and minimax NIT. glm judged it superseded by AD-2 and reported no gap.

  expected_change_site: agents.d/9021-ci-wiring-guard-part2-sharded.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No agents.d fragment was added, which gemini links to failures in tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py. Severity: BLOCKER. sonnet and glm explicitly judged this not a gap.
